implemented.scope: Three outputs of filleting: two sides of flesh and central bone frame; four states round,semidress,dress,fillet. Independent generic geometric marks with captions.
implemented.limits: Compares processing states, not a knife-operation demonstration. Supplier definitions can vary; no claim of guaranteed absence of small bones or suitability for raw consumption.

implemented.scope: Two independent diagrams place probe measurement in food core and infrared measurement on food surface. Blank displays, no invented time/temperature thresholds.
implemented.limits: Measurement-point distinction only; device-specific placement/disinfection/operating instructions remain with manual and restaurant procedure.
